{{short description|Italian researcher}}
'''Valeria Simoncini''' (born 1966){{r|born}} is an Italian researcher in [[numerical analysis]] who works as a professor in the mathematics department at the [[University of Bologna]].{{r|cv}} Her research involves the computational solution of equations involving large [[Matrix (mathematics)|matrices]], and their applications in scientific computing.{{r|unibo}} She is the chair of the [[SIAM]] Activity Group on Linear Algebra.{{r|siam}}

==Education and career==
Simoncini earned a degree from the University of Bologna in 1989, became a [[visiting scholar]] at the [[University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign]] from 1991 to 1993, and completed her PhD at the [[University of Padua]] in 1994. After working at [[National Research Council (Italy)|CNR]] from 1995 to 2000, she returned to Bologna as an associate professor in 2000, and was promoted to full professor in 2010.{{r|cv}}

==Book==
With Antonio Navarra, she is the author of the book ''A Guide to Empirical Orthogonal Functions for Climate Data Analysis'' (Springer, 2010).

==Recognition==
Simoncini was a second-place winner of the [[Leslie Fox Prize for Numerical Analysis]] in 1997.{{r|fox}}
In 2014 she was elected as a [[fellow]] of the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]] "for contributions to [[numerical linear algebra]]".{{r|sf}}
She was named to the 2021 class of fellows of the [[American Mathematical Society]] "for contributions to computational mathematics, in particular to numerical linear algebra".{{r|fams}} In 2023, she was elected to serve on the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics|SIAM]] Council.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Welcoming the Newest Electees to the SIAM Board of Trustees and Council |url=https://sinews.siam.org/Details-Page/welcoming-the-newest-electees-to-the-siam-board-of-trustees-and-council |access-date=2023-03-15 |website=SIAM News |date=23 January 2023 |language=en-US}}</ref>
